apple_impressions.definition: App Store impressions, including product-page views, for the selected period and filters.

apple_unique_impressions.definition: Unique devices that viewed the app on the App Store for the selected period and filters.

apple_product_page_views.definition: Total App Store product-page views for the selected period and filters.

apple_unique_product_page_views.definition: Unique devices that viewed the product page for the selected period and filters.

apple_first_time_downloads.definition: First-time downloads on Apple platforms for the selected period and filters.

apple_redownloads.definition: Manual redownloads, excluding updates and restores, for the selected period and filters.

apple_total_downloads.definition: First-time downloads plus redownloads for the selected period and filters.

apple_conversion_rate_pct.definition: App Store Connect conversion rate: total downloads and eligible pre-orders divided by unique device impressions. Import the console value; do not substitute first-time downloads divided by impressions.

apple_installations.definition: Completed installations reported in App Store Connect usage data.

apple_first_launches.definition: Unique first launches from a source that explicitly reports this population. Leave absent when unavailable.

apple_sessions.definition: App uses lasting at least two seconds in App Store Connect usage data.

apple_average_daily_active_devices_30d.definition: Average daily active devices over the same complete 30-day window as apple_active_devices_30d.

apple_active_devices_30d.definition: Active devices with at least one session in the previous 30 days.

apple_d7_eligible.definition: The day-7-eligible Apple retention cohort denominator.

apple_d7_retained.definition: Members of apple_d7_eligible that returned on day 7 under the same cohort definition.

apple_ratings_count.definition: Current App Store rating count for the selected storefront. This is a point-in-time metric, not additive.

apple_average_rating.definition: Current App Store average rating for the selected storefront.

apple_crashes.definition: Crashes from opted-in App Store users for the selected period and filters.

ios_crash_free_sessions_pct.definition: Direct crash-free-session percentage from a named source. It must not be inferred as one minus crashes divided by sessions.

apple_deletions.definition: App deletions reported for opted-in usage data.

apple_user_loss_rate_pct.definition: A source-defined user-loss rate with its denominator recorded in notes; not derived automatically.

apple_policy_issues.definition: Open policy or review-compliance issues in current App Store Connect state.

google_store_listing_visitors.definition: Users that visited the store listing or mini-detail page and did not already have the app installed, under the selected dimensions.

google_unique_user_install_clicks.definition: Unique users who clicked Install and did not have the app installed on another device.

google_store_listing_acquisitions.definition: Users who visited the listing and installed the app under Google Play's acquisition definition.

google_store_listing_ctr_pct.definition: Unique user install clicks divided by store-listing visitors for the same period and dimensions.

google_installations.definition: Completed installations for the selected period and dimensions. Record the exact Play report path in source_ref.

google_first_launches.definition: Unique first launches for the same population and window as google_installations.

google_average_daily_active_users_30d.definition: Average daily active users over the same complete 30-day window as google_monthly_active_users.

google_monthly_active_users.definition: Monthly active users over the selected complete 30-day window.

google_d7_eligible.definition: The day-7-eligible Google Play retention cohort denominator.

google_d7_retained.definition: Members of google_d7_eligible that returned on day 7 under the same cohort definition.

google_ratings_count.definition: Current Google Play rating count for the selected storefront. This is a point-in-time metric, not additive.

google_average_rating.definition: Current Google Play average rating for the selected storefront.

android_user_perceived_crash_rate_pct.definition: Percentage of daily active users experiencing at least one user-perceived crash in Android vitals.

android_user_perceived_anr_rate_pct.definition: Percentage of daily active users experiencing at least one user-perceived ANR in Android vitals.

android_phone_model_crash_rate_pct.definition: Highest relevant per-phone-model user-perceived crash rate. Record the device model in the device column.

android_phone_model_anr_rate_pct.definition: Highest relevant per-phone-model user-perceived ANR rate. Record the device model in the device column.

wear_model_crash_rate_pct.definition: Highest relevant per-watch-model user-perceived crash rate. Record the watch model in the device column.

wear_model_anr_rate_pct.definition: Highest relevant per-watch-model user-perceived ANR rate. Record the watch model in the device column.

google_user_loss.definition: Users who uninstalled from all devices or became inactive under Google Play's user-loss definition.

google_user_loss_rate_pct.definition: A Play-report user-loss rate with the denominator and population recorded in notes; not derived automatically.

google_policy_issues.definition: Open policy-status issues in current Google Play Console state.
